finding: Level budget and group sizes: monsters equal open tiles in the 80 by 80 window divided by 30 (plus half again in multiplayer, capped at 190); groups are 1 on the first level or on a coin flip, 2 to 3 on the second level or crypt, 3 to 5 otherwise (monster.cpp 3713-3735). Maps to a per-open-tile density knob per zone. Decision: adapt (idea).

Leashed pack gate: the leader steps only when every leashed bodyguard sits inside a 7 by 7 box around its new tile; a bodyguard behind a wall drops out of the count and a separated one reunites under walking distance 4 with a clear line (monster.cpp 4356-4381, 1696-1722). Best transferable idea. Decision: adapt (idea).

Unique boss packs: 70 of 100 uniques carry a leashed pack of 8 bodyguards of their own type at twice the hit points; members copy the leader's wake timer (monster.cpp 526, 352, 1674-1690; unique_monstdat.tsv). A 9-body pack is over the 3-attacker cap, so only 3 may attack. Decision: adapt (idea).

Wake on sight with a memory: a monster in view sets its timer to 255, unseen counts down one per update, zero is dormant; a hit or some attacks reset to 255 (monster.cpp 4314-4317, 1863, 1139; default 20 ticks per second, so about 12.75 s, medium confidence). Decision: adapt (idea).

Theme rooms: one species is chosen per room, then each open tile gets a one-in-f monster (f = 6, 7, 3, 9 for the pit by tileset); a skeleton room is mostly skeletons; a goat shrine is ringed by up to eight of one species (themes.cpp 360-365, 424, 451, 707). Decision: adapt (idea).

Three defects in the same code, fixed in the sketch: the group walk moves y by a second random deltaX (monster.cpp 341); the anchor search (328-331) and the scatter fill (3728) have no cap. Fix: one direction moves both axes; capped tries and rounds.
No respawn or despawn in monster.cpp or levels/*.cpp; the only population rule is the cap. Row 23 needs respawn and despawn-on-empty from elsewhere.

Spawn row: each row loads once per map with a percent chance, a count range, a rectangle with a miss budget of five times the max and a raster fallback (MapRenderer 121-224). Across 107 map files the median is 4.5 enemies per 1000 map tiles (90th percentile 7.8), counting walls. Decision: adapt (idea).

Duplicate-pool rarity: common 6, uncommon 3, rare 1 copies in a pool; each member draws its own species within the category and level window (EnemyGroupManager 96-102; MapRenderer 94). Groups mix species inside one category. Decision: adapt (idea).

Stealth-scaled aggro: join needs line of sight and distance under threat range times (100 minus stealth) percent; leave combat beyond twice the threat range. A line-of-sight memory exit exists but no data file sets cooldown_los (EntityBehavior 154-264; StatBlock 807). Decision: adapt (idea).

Call for help: a hit on an enemy not yet in combat activates a beacon of radius 4.0 tiles (lifespan 33 ms) that pulls allies into the fight; the beacon is included by 15 enemy files (Entity.cpp 360-362; powers/categories/beacon.txt). Decision: adapt (idea).

Wander and patrol: the wander box is the spawn point plus or minus 4 (9 by 9). Waypoint loops are single-enemy only and are rare (3 rows in empyrean_campaign); pauses appear in 2 lines (StatBlock 1517; Map.cpp 634; EntityBehavior 612). Decision: adapt (idea).

Silent-drop defects, fixed in the sketch: placement checks walls only (MapRenderer 93); a missing category still counts the member as placed (MapRenderer 95; EnemyGroupManager 117); an unknown rarity adds zero copies (EnemyGroupManager 105); the global rand() is seeded from time (main.cpp 430). Fix: validate rows at load, occupancy check, seeded RNG, shuffled fallback.

Spawn rows gate on campaign status (requires_status in 6 rows, requires_not_status in 9 rows in empyrean maps; Map.cpp 657). Maps onto our one-ledger flags. No escort link (no leader in src/*.cpp) and no caps or respawn in the group code: row 23 gap.
